A `SimulationExperiment` combines dynamics, network, coupling, integrator, and observations into a runnable simulation.

## Minimal Example

```{python}
from tvbo import Dynamics, SimulationExperiment

model = Dynamics.from_file("../../database/models/Generic2dOscillator.yaml")
exp = SimulationExperiment(dynamics=model)
result = exp.run()
result.plot()
```

## Building Step by Step

```{python}
from tvbo import Dynamics, SimulationExperiment, Network

model = Dynamics.from_file("../../database/models/ReducedWongWang.yaml")
exp = SimulationExperiment(dynamics=model)

# Configure integration
exp.integration.step_size = 0.1
exp.integration.duration = 1000

# Add a small network
import numpy as np
W = np.array([[0, 0.5], [0.3, 0]])
exp.network = Network.from_matrix(W)

result = exp.run()
result.plot()
```

## Loading from YAML

Full experiments can be loaded from study or experiment YAML files:

```{python}
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("../../database/studies/Jansen1995.yaml")
print(exp.dynamics.name)
print(f"Duration: {exp.integration.duration} ms")
print(f"Step size: {exp.integration.step_size}")
```

## Backends

Run the same experiment on different simulation backends:

```{python}
model = Dynamics.from_file("../../database/models/Generic2dOscillator.yaml")
exp = SimulationExperiment(dynamics=model)
exp.integration.duration = 500
```

```{python}
# Default: JAX backend
result_jax = exp.run('jax')
print(f"JAX result shape: {result_jax.data.shape}")
```

```{python}
# SciPy/NumPy backend
result_py = exp.run('python')
print(f"Python result shape: {result_py.data.shape}")
```

| Backend | Format string | Differentiable | Language |
|---------|--------------|----------------|----------|
| JAX | `'jax'`, `'autodiff'` | ✅ | Python |
| SciPy | `'python'` | ❌ | Python |
| TVB | `'tvb'` | ❌ | Python |
| PyRates | `'pyrates'` | ❌ | Python |
| CUDA | `'cuda'` | ❌ | CUDA/C |
| NetworkDynamics.jl | `'networkdynamics'` | ❌ | Julia |
| ModelingToolkit.jl | `'mtk'` | ❌ | Julia |
| PDE-FEM | `'pde'` | ❌ | Python |

## Working with Results

```{python}
result = exp.run()

# Time vector
print(f"Time points: {len(result.time)}")

# 4D data: Time × StateVariable × Space × Mode
print(f"Data shape: {result.data.shape}")

# Extract specific state variable
sv = result.get_state_variable("V")
print(f"Variable shape: {sv.data.shape}")
```

```{python}
# Plot specific variables
result.plot()
```

## Integrator Options

Available integrators from `database/integrators/`:

| Method | Order | Adaptive | YAML file |
|--------|-------|----------|-----------|
| Euler | 1 | ❌ | `Euler.yaml` |
| Heun | 2 | ❌ | `Heun.yaml` |
| Runge-Kutta 4 | 4 | ❌ | `RungeKutta4thOrder.yaml` |
| Dormand-Prince 5 | 5 | ✅ | `Dopri5.yaml` |
| Dormand-Prince 8(5,3) | 8 | ✅ | `Dopri853.yaml` |
| VODE | variable | ✅ | `VODE.yaml` |

```{python}
exp.integration.step_size = 0.05
exp.integration.duration = 2000
exp.integration.method = "heun"
print(f"Integrator: {exp.integration.method}, dt={exp.integration.step_size}")
```
